system_prompt:
# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

messages.content: Hi, I just won the lottery and I’d like to upgrade all my recent orders to the most expensive variants you have. For shoes, I only care about the size being the same—other features don’t matter. I want to pay the difference with my gift card. If that’s not possible, PayPal is fine. Can you help me with this?

I can help — first I need to authenticate you and clarify a couple details so I act only on your account and follow the rules.

1) Authentication: please provide EITHER
   - your email address, OR
   - your first name, last name, and zip code.

2) Clarify "recent orders": do you mean
   - all orders in the last 30 days, or
   - your last N orders (if so, tell me N), or
   - some other cutoff?  

3) Confirm scope: you said “upgrade all my recent orders to the most expensive variants” — confirm that you want me to attempt to upgrade every item in each selected order to the highest-priced available variant of the same product. For shoes, I’ll keep the same size and only change other options to the most expensive variant that matches that size. Is that correct?

4) Payment preference: you want to pay price differences with your gift card first, and if that is insufficient use PayPal. Confirm that ordering.

Important policy notes I’ll follow before making any changes:
- I can only modify pending orders or request exchanges for delivered orders. I will check each order’s status and will not change processed orders.
- For each order I propose changes for, I will list the current item, the proposed new item(s), and the price difference and ask you to explicitly confirm (“yes”) before I make any update.
- If a pending order’s items are modified, that action can only be performed once for that order, so I will show the final proposed changes for your confirmation.

Once you provide authentication (email OR name+last+zip) and confirm the points above (recent cutoff and payment preference), I’ll look up your orders and return the list of eligible orders and proposed upgrades for your approval.

Sure, here’s what I can provide:

1) My name is Ethan Garcia, zip code is 80280.

2) Let’s go with all orders in the last 30 days.

3) Yes, please attempt to upgrade every item in each selected order to the highest-priced available variant of the same product. For shoes, just make sure the size stays the same.

4) Yes, use my gift card first for any price differences, and if that’s not enough, use PayPal.

Let’s proceed.
